sections.Profile:
The "Utah" pinball machine, produced by United Manufacturing Co. in September 1949, is a single-player electro-mechanical game with an American West theme. The playfield features two flippers, four pop bumpers, ten tower bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: United Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: United States, Single Player, Travel, US States, Western, Wood Rail, Original Theme
